primitives.name: Tackle Back Formation
primitives.verbatim_quote: FORMATIONS AND DIAGRAMS OF PLAYS 207 Tackle Back Formation—Right Half Back Run Around Left End.
primitives.assumptions: Fixed offensive linemen assignments, deterministic blocking paths, single-ball carrier.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when any assigned blocker deviates from their path or timing.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI sequential event tree with binary outcomes (success/failure)
layer2.telemetry: Blocked/unblocked binary indicators for each lineman assignment

primitives.name: Right Half Back Speed
primitives.verbatim_quote: The right half back must be speedy and get away quickly.
primitives.assumptions: Constant velocity approximation, negligible acceleration time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs at v_rhb < threshold_velocity, where threshold depends on defensive coverage.

layer2.mapping: Bayesian prior distribution over running speed in GSI models.
layer2.telemetry: Observed time-to-first-contact for the right half back

primitives.name: Right Tackle Cut-Off
primitives.verbatim_quote: Right Tackle goes through and cuts off opponents' half back.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'d_rt': "meters (distance between right tackle and opponent's half back)", 't_c': 'seconds (time to cut-off window)'}
primitives.assumptions: Straight-line pursuit, identical speeds between blockers and targets.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when d_rt > v_rt * t_c, where v_rt is the tackle's approach speed.

layer2.mapping: Conformal prediction interval for interception probability in GSE.
layer2.telemetry: Distance-to-intercept metric tracked by defensive coordinators

primitives.name: Quarter Back Interference
primitives.verbatim_quote: Quarter Back passes ball to half back and goes ahead for interference.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_qb': "meters^2 (effective area of QB's interference zone)", 'v_qb': "meters/second (QB's movement speed)"}
primitives.assumptions: Uniform coverage within A_qb, constant-speed motion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity at A_qb = 0, rendering interference ineffective.

layer2.mapping: GSI utility function penalizes QB interference based on A_qb.
layer2.telemetry: Area swept by QB during the play, measured via tracking data
